exposure: gestational age at time of delivery
outcome: Effective early Kangaroo Mother Care (eKMC) coverage
cohort: The study included 599 low-birth-weight neonates (< 2000g) born or referred to selected hospitals in Oromia region, Ethiopia, between March 2017 and March 2019, who were alive and not referred out within 24 hours.
finding: The study found a low coverage (8.9%) of effective early KMC among eligible neonates, with Caesarean section delivery and very low birth weight associated with lower odds, while birth at 37 completed weeks or later and single births were associated with higher odds.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was associated with lower odds of effective early KMC compared to vaginal delivery.
cross-section timing: Data collected from March 2017 to March 2019
birth_weight: Less than 2000 g (including very low birth weight < 1500 g and low birth weight 1500-2000 g)
gest_age: Premature and at least 37 completed weeks
